ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. On the left are producer plants, labeled Corn, Carrots, Flowering shrub, and Tree. The diagram also has animals such as Mouse, Rabbit, Grasshopper, Deer, Frog, Shrew, Snake, Hawk, Wolf, etc.; the arrows indicate food or energy pointing from the organism being eaten to the animal obtaining energy. Deer is located in the lower somewhat middle part of the diagram, and it can be seen that the arrows pointing to Deer come from the plant producers on the left; no arrows from other animals pointing to Deer are seen. Reasoning: The question asks "what obtains only from producers?" That is, find the organism that has only plant producers as its food source. According to the arrows in the diagram, Deer's input sources come only from producer plants, not other animals. Therefore, the answer is deer.
